title: AI Game Devs, let's collaborate, make a team and build some crazy shit together like a real studio.
author: No_Film_9120
selftext:
There're a few game building hackathons coming soon, instead of making your own games as a solo and sitting 50 hours a week and testing and prompting and searching for assets and so on.

Why not make a **real team** for ourselves and build together?

We can work together and build a really - **REALLY** fucking good game.

We divide the work based on what people are actually good at, try it out for a jam, and see if the chemistry works. ***Zero downside.***

I have Claude and other AIs plus I use my own GPU and Claude to make assets. I've built 3 games on threejs so far and one serious mobile game is in the works.

If you’re interested, hit my DMs and let me know:

1. What games/prototypes have you messed with before (if any)?
2. What’s your preferred setup (engines, coding tools, or art pipeline)?
3. Any specific upcoming hackathon you've got your eye on?
4. Any specific project you're working on/thinking of working on that you'd like more help on?

You don't need to be a senior engineer or anyone with experience, just someone who actually wants to put in the hours, test, and build together. (No pure 'idea guys' though. everyone gets their hands dirty, or you can even contribute with tokens!).

Remember, ***United we stand divided we fall into vibe coded untested slop.***
